title: Sturgis-led raid sinks a Russian ship; marshals burn the No Name Key base
summary: Dan Sheehan tells of Sturgis-led raid sinks a Russian ship; marshals burn the No Name Key base, about 1962 at No Name Key, Florida / Cuba, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: with the with the Cubans launches an assault into Cuba and sinks a Russian ship.

plain: A guest named Danny Sheehan, on podcast host Jesse Michels's show, says that in 1962 a man named Frank Sturgis led a group of Cubans from a base on No Name Key, a small island in Florida, in an attack on Cuba that sank a Russian ship. According to Sheehan, US marshals, federal law officers, then burned down the No Name Key base, with Robert Kennedy, brother of the president, in the story, which he ties to hidden fights inside the government of the time.
